About this book
" Uncommon Danger" is an " Inside
Europe " thriller of
tremendous
topical interest.
It tells the story
of how a British journalist defeated
the attempt of a group of financiers
to secure an oil concession by engi-
neering a war scare in
Eastern
Europe.
The murder of a spy starts
him on a dangerous trail of adven-
ture leading from Nazi Germany to
the oil fields of Rumania.
The
political " gangster " employed by
the financiers is an enemy who kills
first and talks afterwards; a Russian
agent and his lovely sister are allies
as charming as they are effectual.
Rarely, if ever,
has the Central
European scene been painted so
realistically as in
UNCOMMON DANGER
the second book by
Eric Ambler
